# ExploreIndonesia.ai

> AI-powered Indonesia trip planner. We publish hand-picked, day-by-day Indonesia
> itineraries (Bali, Java, Komodo, Flores, Lombok, the Gili Islands, Sumatra,
> Raja Ampat and beyond) and turn travel plans into bookable trips — stays,
> transfers, tours and experiences.

## Itineraries
- [All trips](https://exploreindonesia.ai/trips): Browse every Indonesia itinerary, filterable by destination, length, style, traveller and vibe.
- [7 Days in Bali for First-Timers](https://exploreindonesia.ai/trips/7-days-bali-first-timers): Ubud, Canggu, Nusa Penida and Uluwatu.
- [5 Days in Bali](https://exploreindonesia.ai/trips/5-days-bali-ubud-canggu-uluwatu): Ubud, Canggu and Uluwatu short escape.
- [10 Days in Bali and the Gili Islands](https://exploreindonesia.ai/trips/10-days-bali-gili-islands)
- [7 Days in Yogyakarta and East Java](https://exploreindonesia.ai/trips/7-days-yogyakarta-east-java): Borobudur, Bromo and Ijen.
- [5 Days in Labuan Bajo and Komodo National Park](https://exploreindonesia.ai/trips/5-days-labuan-bajo-komodo)
- [10 Days in Komodo and Flores](https://exploreindonesia.ai/trips/10-days-komodo-flores)
- [14 Days in Raja Ampat for Divers](https://exploreindonesia.ai/trips/14-days-raja-ampat-divers)
- [15 Days in Sumatra](https://exploreindonesia.ai/trips/15-days-sumatra): Bukit Lawang, Berastagi, Lake Toba and Samosir.
- [30 Days in Indonesia: The Ultimate Itinerary](https://exploreindonesia.ai/trips/30-days-indonesia-ultimate)

- Each itinerary is structured day by day with a route, best time to go, where to stay, practical info and FAQs.
- Content is editorial and regularly updated; affiliate links fund the site and are marked accordingly.
